adjudication.rationale: The diff adds new, nontrivial client-side logic in `app/assets/javascripts/embed.js`, including a `message` event listener (`window.addEventListener('message', ...)`), an origin validation check (`if (discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1) { return; }`), and a resize handler that mutates the iframe height (`iframe.height = e.data.height + "px"`). The diff also adds only Ruby/RSpec tests (controller/model/job/component specs) and does not add any JavaScript test files or coverage for this new postMessage/origin-check behavior. So the finding (missing JS test coverage for this logic) is diff-grounded and actionable, but it is not itself a functional defect.
